item.title: Debbie Harry Makes ‘SNL’ Cameo to Introduce Olivia Rodrigo’s ‘drop dead’ Performance
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard, I'm your host. We've got some exciting news from Saturday Night Live. Debbie Harry, the iconic frontwoman of Blondie, made a surprise appearance on the show, introducing Olivia Rodrigo's performance of her new single "drop dead".
[Short music clip of "drop dead" plays]
Host: Rodrigo was pulling double duty as host and musical guest, and Harry's cameo was a highlight of the night. The two women, from different generations, shared a moment that symbolized the connection between their styles of guitar-driven pop with an edge.
[Short music clip of Blondie plays]
Host: Blondie, of course, is a legendary band that pioneered the new wave scene, with over 40 million records sold worldwide. They were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2006. And Olivia Rodrigo, well, she's a pop star on the rise, with her third studio album, "You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love", coming out on June 12.
[Short music clip of Rodrigo's "drivers license" plays]
Host: Rodrigo's performance of "drop dead" was just one of the highlights of the night. She also performed a previously unreleased ballad, "begged", and opened the show with a hilarious monologue that poked fun at her Disney Channel past.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
